# `agent-memory/v1` — <type>_<topic>.md — memory file

<!-- AUTOGENERATED from `Glorbo.FileSpec.MemoryEntryMd` by
     `mix glorbo.docs.file_formats`. Do not edit by hand;
     regen after changing the spec module. -->

One memory entry. Filename prefix (`user_`, `feedback_`,
`project_`, `reference_`) must equal the frontmatter `type:`.
Body capped at 8 KB; total memory dir capped at 100 KB soft
(warning only).

## Frontmatter schema

**Required:** `kind`, `name`, `type`, `description`

**Optional:** *(none)*

### Enums

| Key | Allowed values |
|-----|----------------|
| `type` | `user`, `feedback`, `project`, `reference` |

### Caps (byte limits)

| Target | Bytes |
|--------|-------|
| `body` | 8192 |


## Canonical key order

When the formatter rewrites this file, keys appear in this order:

`kind`, `name`, `description`, `type`

Unknown keys fall after the known block, sorted alphabetically.

## Examples

```markdown
---
kind: agent-memory/v1
name: Director role and preferences
description: Director runs acme solo; prefers Apache-2.0
type: user
---
Director is a one-person shop; Apache-2.0 for new repos.
```
